title: George Baquet and young Sidney Bechet
summary: Billy and Allen try to recall George Baquet of Philadelphia, and Billy remembers Sidney Bechet as a boy playing a clarinet held together with wire.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: You didn't? No. Oh, he had a whole way in quite a few of those. What's this fellow's name in Philadelphia from the Orleans? George something. George Bishop, not Bishop.
George Bakay had been there, but he's dead now too. Oh, is that so?
Bishop Bishop, yes. And many of those old timers are gone now. Yes, yes, yes.

Yeah, we knew Sidney Bishop when he was a kid. Oh, yeah. But he was playing the clarinet then too. He had a whole piece of clarinet strung together with wire. He'd come down and beat a lot of them. They'd let him sit in there along with the police and run him out because he was a kid. He was a little kid, I guess, in short pants. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
Let's run him and Louis out there. Run him out.
